titles.ja: サムライチャンプルー

title.ja: 疾風怒涛 - Tempestuous Temperaments

1.overview: Fuu is a young waitress in search of a Samurai who smells of sunflowers, but she has some unexpected company with her. Mugen and Jin are two samurai who want to kill each other and are always getting arrested. Can these three learn to work with each other?
1.summary:
Fuu is a part-time teahouse worker whose life changes forever when two vagabond warriors, Mugen and Jin, stumble into her place of business and end up in hot water with the local magistrate.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 百鬼夜行 - Redeye Reprisal

2.overview: Mugen's armless rival retuns with some new hired help: Oniwakamaru.
2.summary:
When Mugen wounds an enemys arm, it sets off a dangerous chain reaction. Fuu is kidnapped, and two deadly assassins are dispatched to make short work of vagabond Mugen and ronin Jin.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 以心伝心 其ノ一 - Hellhounds for Hire (Part 1)
title.x-jat: Ishindenshin Sono Ichi - Hellhounds for Hire (Part 1)

3.overview: Mugen and Jin decide to ditch Fuu, but they end up joining opposite sides in a basica gang warfare with Fuu in the middle reminding them of their promise.
3.summary:
After leaving the domineering Fuu behind, Mugen and Jin arrive in town. Once there, it`s not long before theyre hired on as bodyguards by the two clans that run the city.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 以心伝心 其ノ二 - Hellhounds for Hire (Part 2)
title.x-jat: Ishindenshin Sono Ni - Hellhounds for Hire (Part 2)

4.overview: A dice rolling contest will decide the fate of the gang warfare. Who will end up dying as a result?
4.summary:
The paths Mugen, Jin, and Fuu follow bring them together again, but their reunion is put on hold when an untimely mistake intensifies the struggle between two clans fighting for control of one city.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 馬耳東風 - Artistic Anarchy

5.overview: Fuu is targeted as a kidnapper groups next victum. Will the others be able to save her in time?
5.summary:
An unknown artist hires Fuu for a private modeling session, but his passion for painting turns out to be a front for a human trafficking ring. Will Mugen crack the case in time to save Fuu from a life of slavery?
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 赤毛異人 - Stranger Searching

6.overview: The gang enters into an eating competition with Mugen and Jin's swords on the line. After a mysterious man wins the eating competition, they must find a way to get their swords back and save the mysterious man. Will they succeed?
6.summary:
Mugen and Jin loses their weapons - and their appetites - in an rice-eating contest, and the only way to get them back is by posing as tour guides for a mysterious European with a penchant for man love!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 四面楚歌 - Risky Racket

7.overview: A thief was running around town, while Fuu, Jin, and Mugen were going to get some soup.  Fuu was daydreaming and the thief ""accidently"" bumped into Fuu. When Fuu was paying for the soup, she noticed that her purse was gone and said that the man she bumped into took the money. Will Fuu ever get her money back?
7.summary:
Fuu gets caught in a web of deception when she falls for prolific pickpocket with a heart of gold. But when her sticky-fingered friend slips his hands into the wrong pocket, he could be headed for a beat down.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 唯我独尊 - The Art of Altercation

8.overview: A man hunting for Jin has been challenging any samurai wearing glasses he can find, accompanied by a beat-boxing duo of underlings. The question arises as to whether or not he will recognize Jin when he becomes infatuated with Fuu, for Jin has had to pawn his glasses.
8.summary:
A cocky sword-slinger with a crush on Fuu dishes the dirt on Jin`s disgraceful past. If the renegade ronin wants to restore his good name, he will need to get his glasses out of hock and make ready for a throw down!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 魑魅魍魎 - Beatbox Bandits

9.overview: Mugen, Jin, and Fuu need to cross a border so they purchase  Travel Passes since they dont have any.The Travel Passes turn out to be fake.  Mugen, Jin,  and Fuu are sentenced to death.    The guards were going to have them killed until they found out about a errand they needed to run.  So they send Mugen to run the errand for them.  He must travel past a forest full of bandits and trouble to deliver an object.  If Mugen does not make the delivery and come back in time,  Jin and Fuu will die!
9.summary:
The crew is headed for the gallows after getting caught flashing fake travel permits, but Mugen can win back their freedom by out hustling a deranged gang of warrior priests.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 以毒制毒 - Lethal Lunacy

10.overview: Mugen faces the lethal challenge of a Shaolin-trained swordsman and proves equal to the test, while Jin gets stuck doing all the housework. Can Mugen defeat this trained swordsman or will he suffer from his mistakes?
10.summary:
Mugen takes his training to the next level in preparation for a full moon death match with a killer who uses a deadly armor-piercing attack to soak the streets in the blood of his victims.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 堕落天使 - Gamblers and Gallantry

11.overview: Jin comes to the rescue of a lady in distress.  He falls in love and tries to rescue his women from the hard life she has come to face.  Will he save her and himself?
11.summary:
Jin falls in love with a suicidal beauty whose husband sold her into slavery, and Mugen tries to make his fortune in the cutthroat world of beetle sumo wrestling.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 温故知新 - The Disorder Diaries

12.overview: Jin and Mugen read through Fuu's diary and find out that she hasn't been telling them what they need to know.
12.summary:
When Mugen and Jin do the unthinkable and read Fuu`s diary, they are treated to a riveting recap of all their greatest misadventures.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 暗夜行路 其之壱 - Misguided Miscreants (Part 1)
title.fr: Les flibustiers de la nuit (1re partie)

13.overview: Mugens past memories lure himback into his violent past; A pirate makes secret plans.  And the lust for gold brings betrayal.
13.summary:
When Mugen crosses paths with a face his past, he reluctantly signs on for a heist that could land him a fortune in stolen gold. Unfortunately for him, some old friends aren`t to be trusted.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 暗夜行路 其之弐 - Midguided Miscreants (Part 2)
title.fr: Les flibustiers de la nuit (2e partie)

14.overview: When Mugen finds out what the pirate was planning to do, he gets his revenge.
14.summary:
Mugen - double-crossed and headed for the bottom of the ocean - flashes back to his life before he died for the first time. Back on land, a pretty young thing convinces Jin to brandish his blades in the name of vengeance.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 徹頭徹尾 - Bogus Booty

15.overview: The shogun's prettiest ninja ends up giving Mugen and Jin an evening that they will never forget. Meanwhile, Fuu gets large.
15.summary:
Mugen goes under the covers with an undercover investigator who`s out to put the smack down on a murderous ring of counterfeiters. Will he finally get the booty he`s after?
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 酔生夢死 ひと夢 - Lullabies of the Lost (Verse 1)
title.x-jat: Suiseimushi Hitomu - Lullabies of the Lost (Verse 1)

16.overview: Mugen, Jin and Fuu get into a quarrel and separate, and have unexpected encounters; new opponents appear, old grievances return, and Mugen and Fuu meet a mysterious archer.
16.summary:
Tempers flare, harsh words are exchanged, and the gang splinters, each member marching off in a different direction. Mugen and Jin wander into some swordplay, and Fuu ends up at the bottom of a river.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 酔生夢死 ふた夢 - Lullabies of the Lost (Verse 2)
title.x-jat: Suiseimushi Futamu - Lullabies of the Lost (Verse 2)

17.overview: Jin ends a life he hoped to spare.  Continuation of the last episode.
17.summary:
Jin and Fuu reunite, only to be attacked by a vengeance-driven samurai from Jin`s old life. Meanwhile, Mugen takes aim at an arrow-slinging madman who`s at the top of everyone`s most wanted list.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 文武両道 - War of the Words

18.overview: Fuu gets a facelift when kids trade in the sword for the graffiti brush; Jin keeps a promise to a long-lost friend and confronts the shock of the new, while Mugen learns to read and conquers a castle.
18.summary:
Mugen learns his letters from a sake-guzzling maniac, Jin makes good on a promise from many years ago, and Fuu sparks a jealous showdown between two bickering graffiti artists.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 因果応報 - Unholy Union

19.overview: A cynical charlatan fleeces the Hidden Christian flock, Fuu gets closer to the Sunflower Samurai, and a truth is finally revealed.
19.summary:
Fuu harbors a female fugitive who`s on the run from a bogus, gun-slinging missionary. The new girl is trouble, no doubt about it, but she may hold the finding the samurai who smells like sunflowers.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 悲歌慷慨 其之壱 - Elegy of Entrapment (Verse 1)
title.pl: Tren o wiecznej tułaczce, werset pierwszy
title.x-jat: Hika Kougai Sono Ichi - Elegy of Entrapment (Verse 1)

20.overview: Fuu, Mugen and Jin meet up with a blind girl who is a traveling musician.  Because of her blindness, she is able to sense the emotions of the group.  Is this girl more than just a musician?
20.summary:
Mugen defends the honor of beautiful blind songstress, but when the when the trio of wanderers becomes a quartet, Fuu will be faced with an impossible decision.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 悲歌慷慨 其之弐 - Elegy of Entrapment (Verse 2)
title.pl: Tren o wiecznej tułaczce, werset drugi
title.x-jat: Hika Kougai Sono Ni - Elegy of Entrapment (Verse 2)

21.overview: Jin learns the Way of Water, a woman's sorrow comes to an end, and Mugen both gives and receives an assassin's last gift.
21.summary:
Mugen`s has his own deadly run-in with the same blind beauty that sent Jin plummeting towards a gruesome end. Who is this seductive assassin, and why is she targeting the Champloo crew?
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 怒髪衝天 - Cosmic Collisions

22.overview: On the way to Nagasaki the trio falls in a hole and ends up in a mine. The trio ends up working for the owner of the mine for a share of the treasure. As the days drag on Fuu discovers that they are becoming more and more like the seemingly-alive workers.
22.summary:
Jin, Mugen, and Fuu fall into the clutches of a hoard of rotting zombie treasure hunters. Next, they get blown to oblivion by an asteroid. Or maybe they just ate some bad mushrooms.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 一球入魂 - Baseball Blues

23.overview: An anachronistic batch of American belligerents sail into town and a canny ninja-turned-team manager enlists our heroes to do battle with them on the field of honor...which in this case is a baseball diamond. Behold Mugen's pitching skills and tremble!
23.summary:
Mugen`s failed attempt at a dine-and-dash restaurant caper lands him in hot water with the locals. Redemption lies with leading the towns baseball team to a victory over the arrogant and unwelcome Americans.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 生死流転 其之壱 - Evanescent Encounter (Part 1)
title.de: Der ewige Wandel von Leben und Tod (Teil 1)

24.overview: Fuu, Mugen and Jin have finally arrived in Nagasaki to find Ikitsuki island in search of the Sunflower Samurai.  There seems to be one small problem that might keep them from getting there though.  A group of assassins are following closely behind.
24.summary:
As the crew draws ever nearer their final destination, Fuu makes a bold and startling decision. Elsewhere, unnamed adversaries pursue the travelling trio.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 生死流転 其之弐 - Evanescent Encounter (Part 2)
title.de: Der ewige Wandel von Leben und Tod (Teil 2)

25.overview: As Jin duels Kagetoki Kariya, the most powerful man in the shogunate, Mugen has to contend with three brothers who want his head. Will they survive?
25.summary:
Jin enters a bloody grudge match with the man responsible for the ruin of his rep. Meanwhile, Mugen races to save Fuu from the clutches of a sadistic madman bent on bloodshed.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 生死流転 其之参 - Evanescent Encounter (Part 3)
title.de: Der ewige Wandel von Leben und Tod (Teil 3)
title.fr: Le samurai qui ne sentait plus rien

26.overview: As Fuu finally confronts the Sunflower Samurai, Mugen and Jin face their ultimate tests. While Mugen must face one of the three insane brothers, Jin continues his battle with Kagetoki Kariya. And there's the small matter of their own duel...
26.summary:
Old scores are finally settled as Mugen, Jin, and Fuu finally come face to face with the ghosts of their respective pasts.
Source: crunchyroll
